passages.claim: The cone is the actual set of finite nonnegative combinations of the supplied rays. Generator membership, addition, nonnegative scaling and positivity of a supporting linear functional are proved from its coefficients.

A vanishing nonnegative support sum forces every coefficient outside its zero support plane to vanish. When precisely two distinct endpoint generators have zero support value and all others have strictly positive value, the actual cone face is exactly their positive wedge. No face-area or balance formula is an input.

The actual inverse normal-section chart reconstructs endpoint rays in the support plane and preserves their norms and inner product. A geometric face equality pulls back to the actual positive planar wedge. Its actual polar angular measure is proved equal to arccos of the endpoint inner product via Gaussian planar polar integration, not supplied as a premise.

The halfspace outward normal is exactly minus the supplied inward spherical conormal, transported into original coordinates. Its support dot product, unit norm and signed inward identification are all proved, fixing the positive sign in the final vector identity.

Injectivity of the unordered endpoint-pair indexing and the zero/strict support incidences give a genuine relative-interior point on each listed cone facet: the sum of its endpoint rays. Those strict facet points prove pairwise nonparallelism. Ambient full dimension alone is not incorrectly used for this conclusion.

The coefficient and chart proofs give the actual angular measure of every generated support face. The structural geometric completeness hypothesis remains EXPLICIT: a point belongs to the finite generated cone iff every listed inward conormal has nonnegative inner product with it. Under this condition the generated cone equals the actual halfspace cone and its actual facet angular weight equals the ordinary endpoint angle. This packet does not construct that complete presentation for every original nonsimple polyhedral face.

For arbitrary finite edge count, the actual ordinary endpoint-angle-weighted signed inward conormal sum equals twice the actual spherical vector integral of the generated cone, and its norm is at most twice the actual polar spherical area. Unit rays/conormals, actual endpoint/support incidence, distinct endpoint pairs, nonparallel endpoint rays and the geometric halfspace completeness equivalence remain explicit; no balance, angular mass or area bound is assumed.

The planar radial integral is one and the three-dimensional vector first-moment radial integral is two.

Strict support incidences and distinct endpoint pairs supply genuine relative-interior facet points and hence nonparallel outward halfspace normals; no invalid inference from ambient full dimension alone is made.

The theorem permits any finite number of edges. Actual original-polyhedron face/ridge indexing, complete normal-cone presentation and conormal construction remain separate model obligations; no printed nonsimple ridge Green identity or final H1 acceptance claim follows from this packet alone.
